intentions.title: Establish an evidence baseline
intentions.description: Run the same maintenance task with ordinary maintenance, AI without a research representation, and at least two tracked approaches.

intentions.title: Define semantic fidelity
intentions.description: Make semantic fidelity observable enough that independent reviewers can agree or record disagreement.

intentions.title: Measure change value
intentions.description: Test whether an abstraction improves a subsequent change rather than only explaining an existing system.

intentions.title: Control abstraction risk
intentions.description: Define when an approach is useful, too costly, contradicted, or ready to archive.

intentions.title: Separate representation from AI
intentions.description: Determine whether observed gains come from the representation, the AI workflow, or ordinary engineering discipline.
